messages.content:
A reader of a contract claims that the quoted passages below settle a statement (the hypothesis). You do not see the contract; judge only from the quotes.

<hypothesis>
Confidential Information shall only include technical information.
</hypothesis>

<claimed_label>
Contradiction
</claimed_label>

<quotes>
<quote>Confidential Information shall mean all information provided by Disclosing Party with respect to the Invention regardless of whether it is written, oral, audio tapes, video tapes, computer discs, machines, prototypes, designs, specifications, articles of manufacture, drawings, human or machine readable documents.</quote>
<quote>Confidential Information shall also include all information related to the Invention provided by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party prior to the signing of this agreement.</quote>
</quotes>

The labels mean:
- Entailment: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is true.
- Contradiction: the quotes state or clearly imply that the hypothesis is false.

Decide whether the quotes, taken as written, are enough on their own to support the claimed label. Answer supports = false if the quotes are about something else, support the opposite label, support only part of the hypothesis, or need context the quotes do not give.

Answer only with the JSON object the response format asks for: supports (true or false) and a one-sentence reason.

content.text: {"supports":true,"reason":"The quotes define Confidential Information as all information provided about the Invention in any form, including pre-agreement disclosures, which is not limited to technical information and so contradicts the hypothesis."}
